title: Rope Bowl

description:
A rope spirals around to create a small bowl.

All of my rope models can be found in collections on MakerWorld and Printables.

**Print Settings**

No special settings needed

The following filaments were used in the pictures above:

- Polymaker PolyTerra Sapphire Blue
- Polymaker PolyTerra Army Red
- Polymaker PolyTerra Forest Green
- Polymaker PolyTerra Pastel Banana
